title: Copilot Studio 2026: govern intent-to-action agents
decision: Fund governed agent scale where workflows merit managed automation.
summary: Bottom line: use Copilot Studio as a governed agent platform, moving from business intent to useful action while funding workflows that merit scale, with rigor.

claims.text: Copilot Studio is a low-code studio for agents, workflows and agent flows that connect to business data and publish to work channels.
Generative orchestration lets agents choose tools, knowledge, topics or other agents, ask for missing inputs and compose responses.
Tools move intent to action through connectors, agent flows, prompts, REST APIs, MCP and computer use, with policy restrictions available.
Enterprise control includes data policies, audit visibility, Agent 365 governance, Entra agent identities and security controls.
Executives should treat Copilot Studio as a managed agent platform with monitoring, governance, evaluations, administration and policy gates.

voice.narration:
Bottom line: use Copilot Studio as a governed agent platform, moving from business intent to useful action while funding workflows that merit scale, with rigor.

Copilot Studio is a low-code studio for building and managing agents. Teams create agents, workflows and agent flows tied to business data, systems and work channels.

Generative orchestration is the decision layer. It lets an agent choose topics, tools, knowledge or other agents, ask for missing input, and then compose the response.

Tools are where intent turns into action. Govern connectors, agent flows, prompts, REST APIs, MCP and computer use for both modern apps and legacy screens under policy.

Scale only with enterprise controls attached. Data policies, audit logs, Agent 365, Entra identities, spend controls and evaluations keep the platform managed at scale.
